title: radio.py: delayed TX uses snapshot position, live hop channel
description:
## Problem

start_transmission queues TxStartDelayedEvent with position=node.position and channel at request time (jitter, or 9098.42 listen_period_us; default listen is 1 s).

When the event fires, _do_start_transmission refreshes channel = node.get_hop_channel() (TX-instant hop) but still passes the event's position into Medium.start_tx. RadioMixin._handle_tx_start_delayed re-queues the extra log-density delay with the same event.position.

update_position exists for mobility. A node that moves during listen/jitter radiates from the old coordinates while hopping on the new channel. Capture/RSSI/heard_set for density-aware startup are then computed on a stale antenna location. Channel was deliberately made live; position was not.

## Files

- python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py (start_transmission, _handle_tx_start_delayed, _do_start_transmission)
- python/src/lichen/sim/events.py (TxStartDelayedEvent.position)
- python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/nodes.py (update_position)
